name: orthomcl-toxoplasma-me49-expanded-over-falciparum-3d7
turns: Find ortholog groups where Toxoplasma gondii ME49 has at least 5 proteins and Plasmodium falciparum 3D7 has exactly 1.
rationale: A protein count in one genome is a unit without T: the ME49 code with at least 5 and the 3D7 code with exactly 1, joined by AND.

provenance.curatorNote: Protein counts per genome with no clade and no ratio.
